strategy.overview: Miss-O is a feed-dependent upper-playfield game with a valuable center horseshoe. Shoot up top until A-B-C-D is complete, which lights the horseshoe for Extra Ball when enabled. The mystery saucer advances the ball-count feature by one to five; reaching 15 lights both bottom rollovers for Special.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Miss-O, keep shooting up top until A-B-C-D is complete. That lights the center horseshoe for Extra Ball when enabled. The mystery saucer advances the ball-count feature by one to five; reach 15 to light both bottom Special rollovers. Use the horseshoe only when its return is safe.
strategy.summary: Favor upper-playfield shots unless the center horseshoe is easy and feeds safely on this copy. Complete A-B-C-D before taking the lit horseshoe, and use the mystery saucer to push the ball-count feature toward 15. Do not flip blindly while the ball is below the bottom-center bumper.

quickInfo.name: Complete A-B-C-D
quickInfo.summary: Light the center horseshoe for Extra Ball when that award is enabled.

quickInfo.name: Mystery saucer
quickInfo.summary: Advances the ball-count feature by a random one to five steps.

quickInfo.name: Reach 15
quickInfo.summary: Light both bottom rollovers for Special.

quickInfo.name: Bottom-center zone
quickInfo.summary: A ball can return to play from below the bumper; flipping too early can send it under a flipper.

steps.text: Send the ball up top and collect the A-B-C-D letters.
Use the mystery saucer when available to advance the ball-count feature by one to five.
After A-B-C-D is complete, shoot the lit center horseshoe only if its miss and exit feeds are safe.
Continue advancing the ball-count feature to 15, then collect a lit bottom rollover if Special matters.
When the ball enters the bottom-center bumper area, wait until it is clearly above a flipper before flipping.

buildsToward.title: A lit horseshoe and the 15-count rollover awards

steps.text: Complete A-B-C-D for the horseshoe award.
Advance the count through the mystery saucer and upper switches.
Reach 15, then use a lit bottom rollover when its award is active.

machineSetup: Confirm whether Extra Ball and Special are enabled or converted, the tilt penalty, and how the ball-count feature is labeled on the installed Miss-O or Cue-T copy.

Test every A-B-C-D switch and lamp, the center horseshoe and exit, mystery saucer and one-to-five advance, 15-count unit, both bottom rollover lamps, bottom-center bumper, and under-flipper drain paths.
